resources.string: Factory data backup
Review an interrupted data backup

Review every value below. This is a plaintext, unencrypted data file. Arbitrary values may contain secrets or private information; secret detection and secret backup are unsupported. Package and signer labels only establish compatibility and do not authenticate this file or prove who created it. Approval applies only to the exact tables or keys, values and mode shown. Signing-identity backup is a separate feature.
The document provider you choose may upload or cloud-sync the exported plaintext file. Choose a destination appropriate for all of these values.
I reviewed all values and understand the plaintext, private-data and unauthenticated-file risks.
Exact operation, selected data, mode and compatibility labels
Rows by table: archive rows / current destination rows (imports)

REPLACE SELECTED TABLES: Every existing row in each selected destination table will be deleted and replaced by the incoming rows, including when the incoming table is empty. Other tables are unchanged. The current destination row counts above are the deletion impact.
Complete canonical archive values (control and direction-changing characters are escaped)
Approve exact plan
Use this destination for this exact export
Cancel and close
I closed any old document task; acknowledge unknown outcome
Verifying the installed app and exact archive. Please wait.
Review the chosen destination. A separate confirmation is required before returning its temporary write permission.
This review was interrupted or revoked. Its outcome is unknown and it will not be replayed. Close any previous document task yourself before acknowledging recovery.
This review is unavailable, expired or changed. No new approval can be given.
The original document task has not reported its terminal result. Cancellation does not prove that another task has closed.
Selected key / currently present at destination (imports)

Only the selected string key-value entries are included. This does not include presentation settings, all app preferences or SQLite tables. SQLite and key-value restore are separate operations. A failed or interrupted persistence call may already have changed memory or disk; no rollback or automatic retry occurs. A success reports that Android commit returned true, not a guarantee against power loss.
REPLACE SELECTED KEYS: The incoming value overwrites each selected destination key, or creates it if absent. Other keys are preserved. No keys are deleted.
